title: Moving from Addis Ababa to Adama (Nazret): Distance & Route Guide
excerpt: Addis to Adama moves (~100 km): highway timing, two-home handoffs, industrial relocations, and how distance pricing differs from in-city Bole jobs.
content:
Addis to Adama (Nazret)

Adama is one of the most common inter-city legs from Addis for families and factories (~100 km). Price reflects fuel, crew hours on road, and access at both origin condo and destination compound—not bedroom count alone.

Route and timing

  • Leave Addis early to clear outbound congestion toward the Bishoftu–Adama corridor.
  • Confirm destination gate hours—some industrial sites accept trucks only mornings.
  • Rainy season can slow highway legs; build buffer for handover same day.
  • Avoid festival road closures near central Addis on load day—holiday calendar.

Quote structure

Written quotes should list Addis load, highway transit, and Adama unload separately. Ask whether overnight hold is included if you cannot receive goods the same evening.

Packing for highway transit

Use blankets and stretch wrap on upholstered items; secure loads against shifting on longer drives than cross-town hops—fragile packing · materials guide.

Industrial vs residential

Factory relocations may need crane or pallet gear not used on apartment moves—declare equipment at survey. Residential compounds still require truck plate registration before gate entry.

Pricing drivers

Compare to Bishoftu/Sululta guide—Adama is farther; single consolidated truck beats partial shuttles.
